Description

One-story house in Residencial Cumbres, a tree-lined gated community in northern Cancún with a guarded entrance. Open layout across kitchen, living and dining areas, three bedrooms with generous closets, and a covered backyard perfect for evenings outside. Ready for you to furnish as you like, with stationary gas hookup and a solar water heater.
